scope: All tracked data/*.json HTTP(S) string values, deduplicated by removing only fragments. Positive rows are summarized; all non-positive results and redirects are listed below.
tool_role: Original observation tool, not the hardened shipped successor. Pre-release review added explicit multicast rejection for literal and DNS destinations. Original observations and hashes remain unchanged; no second live crawl is claimed.
limitations: HEAD 2xx is availability only; not identity or compatibility
No HTML soft-error detection unless GET fallback fetched a prefix
No bodies retained; bytes_read is prefix bytes delivered to this application
No circuit breaker; each target attempted unless duration cutoff
